column1: # stable, compatibility-only, experimental, wrapper-only, test-only, example-only,
# stable: covered by the core v3 API compatibility promise and release API gate.
# compatibility-only: stable for migration-shaped APIs that should not guide new generic designs.
# experimental: maintained but not protected by the stable API gate.
# wrapper-only: thin convenience package; behavior belongs to the delegated adapter.
# test-only, example-only, generated, tooling, excluded: not public API promises.
# direct-tests: package has direct Go tests for its own behavior.
# wrapper-smoke-tested: tests prove constructor/defaults, interface satisfaction,
# disabled or nil behavior where applicable, and option propagation for thin wrappers.
# test-support: package supports tests and may be covered by consuming contract tests.
# example-only: package is build-smoke checked; it is not behavior-complete coverage.
# generated, tooling, excluded: validated by generation/tooling/docs contracts as applicable.
# needs-tests: release blocker until replaced with direct tests or a documented exception.
